A long time ago I learned how to make the perfect Gin martini from a bartender in S.F. and have been making them this way ever since. Take your cocktail glass and put some crushed ice into it, then pour just a bit of dry vermouth on top of the ice. Then pour the gin into your shaker, with a lot of crushed ice, and shake the motherfucking shit out of it. The shaking bruises the gin (releasing a lot of the aromatics in the process as well as softening the gin as the ice melts and ads water to the cocktail). Take the cocktail glass, swirl it around so that the vermouth has covered all of the sides of the glass...and then dump the entire contents into the sink. Enough vermouth will stick to the sides of the glass to flavor the Martini without making it "wet". Empty the shaker into the glass, throw a few olives on a toothpick in there and you will have made the best Martini you have ever had.

I have been waiting for so many years to share this recipe, you are the first to hear it from me. Enjoy.
